note: New full-width chart under the three price columns: BTC PRICE + ETH PRICE overlay. Same card chrome, same LIVE badge, same 11 timeframes (1H..5Y), same crosshair tooltip and status line as the gold cards, because it is one more entry in the same OVERLAYS engine rather than a second implementation. BTC on the left axis, ETH on the right: on a shared axis a ~1e5 BTC would flatten ETH into a straight line. Axis labels drop the cents ($110,432) since a five-figure label with cents does not fit the gutter; the tooltip still shows them. It reuses the bitcoin/usd and ethereum/usd series the gold cards already fetch, so it adds no new calls to the rate-limited price API. Two fixes on the news page. The V16 headline read "V16 activates at block 30,000", which at height 27,645 can be read as already active - it now says activation is SCHEDULED and carries a badge that the chain decides: NOT YET ACTIVE with the blocks remaining, UPGRADE WINDOW OPEN from #29,900, ACTIVE from #30,000. And the jackpot figures were frozen in the copy; the count of draw heights now comes from getblockcount over the read-only public RPC, with the dated snapshot kept as what it is. The per-draw AMOUNT is deliberately not recomputed here - the explorer archive parses it from each jackpot transaction and stays the single source. If the node cannot be reached the static text simply stays. News page brought up to date - it stopped on 2026-09-07 with the first DTD Jackpot payout, while V16, four releases and a documentation overhaul happened since. Four entries added: V16 activating at #30,000 with the #29,900-#30,000 operator window and the 0/0 heartbeat rule for the first draw at #30,186; the v16.2.x line that took every operator credential out of argv, with the published binary hashes and why .1/.2/.3 followed (the CLI money paths were still reading RPC answers by substring search, and createnodebind always bound the key labelled default - which would have stopped miners whose signing key carries another label from entering the Jackpot at all); the documentation audit that moved Gold Vault and PoPC to a historical record and removed every gold-backed claim including the page metadata; and the explorer work - jackpot archive reachable from five places, the cooldown card removed from the jackpot panel, two separate eligibility indicators, the cadence corrected to every-block, the PoW window corrected to 2,016. The jackpot panel showed one eligibility number - 193 under the 20,000-block window - which is the rule in force TODAY and stops applying at #30,000. Read alone it suggested those 193 addresses are already qualified for the V2 draw. There are now two cards side by side: JACKPOT ELIGIBLE NOW (20k), labelled current rule until #29,999, and FROM #30,000 - DIFFERENT RULE, stating >=3 blocks per 2,016 plus NODE_BIND, that the current count does not carry over, and that the first draw at #30,186 needs 0/0 heartbeats. Explorer header scaled to the main site. Measured in the browser first: the main site renders its logo and module tiles at 110x110 with the brand at 26px/3px, while the explorer used 90x90 and 22.5px/2.5px - visibly smaller on the same screen. The explorer now uses the same values, with the block padding and gaps scaled by the same ratio and the header link row moved 13.75px to 16px so it does not look small beside the bigger tiles. No redesign: same layout, same colours, same order, same spacing ratios. The NEWS tile sizes itself from its sibling so it followed automatically, and HIDE NAV is styled by the shared nav-toggle.js and already renders identically on both pages. Found by reading the rendered panel in a browser rather than the source: the V16 preview inside the DTD Jackpot panel still said eligibility needs 3 SbPoW blocks in the last 5,000. The V16.1 window is 2,016 - the 5,000 figure was the V16.0 draft. Corrected, and the panel now also states that the first draw at #30,186 requires 0/0 heartbeats, ramping to 3-of-4 from #31,338. Jackpot archive reachable from everywhere it is asked for, and the cooldown card that did not belong in a jackpot panel is gone. The DTD Jackpot panel had a card titled NORMAL DTD RECENT-MINER COOLDOWN - a normal-DTD rule, in the panel of a draw that has no cooldown at all, which is the clearest way to teach somebody the wrong thing. That slot is now JACKPOT ARCHIVE: the number of jackpots paid, click to open the full winners table. The cooldown itself is not lost - it is explained in the eligibility section, stated as normal DTD only, with the same expandable identity list. The JACKPOTS PAID card is clickable and opens the same archive. The View all jackpots button no longer requires the last winner to have loaded first (replay needs it, the archive reconstructs from chain and does not), so the archive is always reachable. The winner overlay that appears on a live or replayed jackpot got the same button, because that is where people ask about previous draws. All five entry points call one function, SJP.openArchive, over one data source. Banner and explorer corrected against what is actually published. (1) The operational notice still said the final binaries, hashes and operator guide WOULD be published before the window - they are published: tag v16.2.3, three binaries and SHA256SUMS, downloaded back and verified. It now states the release is available and links it. (2) The upgrade guide moved to a version-neutral URL, sost-upgrade.html, with the old sost-upgrade-v1622.html left as a redirect so no existing link breaks. (3) The 0/0 heartbeat requirement for the FIRST draw at #30,186 is now stated next to the four Jackpot requirements, not sixty lines below them, so nobody concludes they cannot enter for lack of heartbeat history. (4) The explorer DTD card said permanent 1-of-3; since V15 (#25,000) the draw happens on EVERY block - 3-of-3 - and the subtitle now computes all three eras. (5) Atomic swap: the console said the feature was activating at block 16,000 (long passed) and the DEX status legend said BTC lands with V15 (V15 passed and BTC is still OFF); both now state that the SOST-side gates are live, the EVM contract is undeployed and unaudited, and the Bitcoin leg is OFF in the official binaries. (6) Gold terminology removed from the metadata of thirteen pages: gold backed crypto, gold backed coin, constitutional gold. The update window is unchanged: node AND miner, after #29,900 and before #30,000, with consensus activating by itself at #30,000.
